title: Green Checklist and Jackpot Card Templates
whatItIs: A stock-vector page showing two related templates below a lime-lit hero: a dark post with a lime heading, two checkbox items and curved lime lines with contact icons at the base, and a dark green square post with a mint tilted headline card over a white card and a chip graphic.
whatItMeans: Curved neon lines and checkbox bullets give a dark template a technical polish, and stacked tilted cards give the promo depth.
techniques: Curved thin lime lines crossing a dark canvas
Small x marks as decorative accents
Contact icons anchored to the base

vocabulary.definition: A boxed tick used in place of a list dot.
A thin curved line used as decoration.
Overlapping cards giving a layered look.
